affected_party: QIF maintainers and AI agents relying on verifier output
actual_problem: Only the quality-gate verifier has retained negative fixture coverage, so other verifier surfaces can weaken without an obvious failing fixture.
why_it_matters: QIF claims executable structural discipline; unfixture-tested verifier rules are harder to trust and easier to regress.
why_now: v0.4.0 established the quality-gate fixture pattern and the roadmap names expansion as the near-term Phase 1 gap.
